_comment: Canonical mutate scope for the crypto mutation gate (ADR 0045). The single source of truth for WHAT Stryker mutates, read by both web/stryker.config.mjs (the mutator) and scripts/mutation_meta_check.py (the guard that asserts something was in fact mutated) — two languages, neither able to parse the other's config, so a restated scope would drift the mutator and its guard apart. Paths are web-relative (Stryker's cwd = web/). An EXPLICIT file list, never a directory glob: ADR 0045 §3 curates a logic tier and excludes the wiring layer — a file goes in only when it is pure at FILE granularity, because Stryker mutates whole files. Measured, which is why the argon workers are absent — argon.worker.ts 0.00% (21/21 NoCoverage: no test ever instantiates the Worker) and argonWorker.ts 19.67% (worker-vs-fallback PATH survivors: the tests pin the crypto RESULT, byte-identical either way), against v1.ts's 97.76%. Both are execution placement, not crypto; scoring them together reports the misleading number §3 exists to prevent. TIER 2 (cr-0174, measured 2026-07-19, each file whole-file/--force): the pure crypto-logic ring in features/spaces/ — epochs.ts, grant.ts, inviteName.ts — each measures 100% and is ADDED. grant.ts has no own test (its 4 mutants are covered by grantDelivery/rotation/inviteName siblings) and stays in scope with no new test — the file-without-a-test edge decided by measurement. EXCLUDED as wiring/mixed at file granularity: scopes.ts (65%, every export is I/O — crypto inlined in async bodies, not exported pure), identityPins.ts (74%, retry arithmetic + parse guards; only safetyNumber is pure), tree.ts (74%, real pure gaps — slugify folding, trim-regex, fnv1a bound — drowned in contentApi wiring), deviceKeyWrap.ts (71%, IndexedDB/WebCrypto, does not import v1). tree.ts and identityPins.ts are flagged for a future lift-then-add CR (extract the pure crypto into exported pure functions, then admit those) per §3's forcing function.
